data.body: Interim debugging evidence (Phase 1/2): replication_log shows the first auth failures at 2026-09-08T00:00:33Z and current failures still say `Cannot log in at github.com:22`; JGit is trying ssh-ed25519 key SHA256:jBCGL6vjKQfNJQjW9qs43uVpUp7Nfo/2Ygx3kgN7Rmk, which GitHub refuses. The live host/container mounted deploy key is SHA256:iJ7j98LfAGhV+gz4JpEOuCSDAAZUYR9FPuayfCSwW9c (`rebar-gerrit-replication-rotated-20260907`) and an in-container ssh -T to git@github.com succeeds with it. Working vs failing difference: ordinary ssh reads the rotated key from /var/gerrit/.ssh and authenticates, but the running Gerrit/JGit replication plugin continues using a stale in-memory old key. Object-store queue/missing-object is not the first failing mode: failures are pure publickey auth before push content transfer. Next minimal operational fix is restart only the Gerrit container to reload the mounted SSH key/config, then trigger replication start --all --wait and verify GitHub main catches up.
